status: Retrospective source-arithmetic audit after source inspection; not benchmark preregistration.
scope: Complete sourceFigure4table:24compounds,4nominaltemperatures,two reaction mixtures and three equilibrium aliquots per mixture. No selection by MetaG/dGbyG prediction or error.
numerical_checks: Every compiled product equals2mM times raw product fraction.
Every retained apparent equilibrium constant equalsx²/((1−x)(5−x)).
All576raw observations retained with explicit source-compilation inclusion mask.
missing_value_policy: Absent compiled product cell means excluded by the source compilation, not zero product or zero free energy. Missing raw observations or duplicate keys are errors.
uncertainty_scope: Spectral-fit spread is not total reference uncertainty. Two reaction replicates are not six independent equilibrations. Source exclusion decisions are preserved, not independently physically justified.
thermodynamic_quantity: Buffered apparent concentration equilibrium ratio. No activity-based standard or transformed Gibbs label is constructed.
